items.english: Before you plough a slope, buy a spray or fence off a spring, ask three questions.
items.draft: ... uthenge ityhefu yokutshiza okanye uthinge umthombo, buza imibuzo emithathu.
items.backtranslation: ... buy a poison spray or block a spring ...
items.problem: 'fence off a spring' (protect it) became 'block a spring' (damage it): wrong action in a water-source safety example.
items.corrected: ... uthenge ityhefu yokutshiza okanye ubophe umthombo ngothango, buza imibuzo emithathu.

items.english: Keep a notebook of the rain, the first and last frosts, and when things flower.
items.problem: Garbled, ungrammatical word for 'flower'; the observation instruction is unclear.

items.english: Many farmers begin big, with fire in the belly, and lose heart when the patch is too big to manage.
items.draft: Abalimi abaninzi baqala ngokuphakamisa, benenkalipho enkulu ...
items.problem: 'begin big' mistranslated as 'start by lifting'; the warning against starting too big is lost.
items.corrected: Abalimi abaninzi baqala ngokukhulu, benenkalipho enkulu ...

items.english: one crop over a big area and often from near-identical seed
the branching of a river or a tree
items.draft: ukuthi nga kwesebe lomlambo okanye lomthi
items.backtranslation: 'ukuthi nga' of a branch of river or tree (unclear, garbled)
items.problem: Garbled phrase, meaning of 'branching' not recoverable.
